best_idea: Keep one decayed chat-rate estimate per player: each line adds the same amount to a rate that decays between lines, the rate is rescaled so a warn band (note only) and a mute band (fixed timer) sit on it, and an admin exemption sits in front of both.
decision_why: The decayed-rate gate and its warn-then-mute bands fit chat intake; the donor has a zero-interval NaN defect (automod.rs 157), never prunes its player map (60, 88), and exempts group and faction chat (comp/chat.rs 197, automod.rs 104); fix those and keep the bands as data. GPL-3.0 so clean-room only.
acceptance: Server test: 8 lines from one player at 100 ms spacing gives a warning note on line 6 and a 180 s mute refusal on line 8; a zero-ms repeat leaves the rate finite; the first line after the mute ends is delivered with no note.
